evidence.text: “Damage” means **Damage to Invaders** unless explicitly stated otherwise. Normal Spirit Damage does not harm Dahan or the land. Distribute Damage among Invaders in the target land however you wish; Explorers need not be hit first. Damage from separate normal Powers and counterattacks can accumulate within a turn. A piece is destroyed immediately when its marked Damage reaches/exceeds its Health. Reduced Health can also destroy a previously damaged piece; Damage does not itself reduce Health. If a damaged piece moves out of a Health bonus or into a Health penalty and is thereby destroyed, destruction occurs in its destination land, never in an in-between location. [FAQ if-an-invader-with-health-bonus-and-damage-is-moved-where-is-it-destroyed]

- **Reading choices and Damage:** In **Crops Wither and Fade**, always gain 2 Fear before the City-or-Town replacement choice; “or” only divides adjacent clauses. **Veil the Night's Hunt** must put each point on a different Invader, wasting excess when there are fewer Invaders than Dahan. An unqualified “+N Damage” threshold adds total Damage at that step, not N to every previously damaged piece. Damage boosts still belong to the original Power when it counts what it destroyed. [Core: .9v5kavn, .7w4g8qc, .7w4g8p0, is-boosted-damage-from-the-same-source]

clause_coverage_check.clause: Mists of Oblivion does 1 Damage to each Town/City in its target. Does this automatically destroy healthy buildings? Can Damage boosts count for its destruction-based Fear?
clause_coverage_check.ruling: One Damage does not destroy healthy Town/City. Damage boosts remain part of original Power when counting what it destroyed.
